primary_contribution.instructions: What is the paper's primary contribution? Mixed/other applies when no single primary contribution dominates. Judge only the supplied paper text; do not use outside knowledge.

criteria.method_system: A new method, algorithm, model architecture or system.
criteria.dataset_resource: A new dataset, corpus, annotation set or other reusable resource.
criteria.benchmark_evaluation_method: A new benchmark, evaluation protocol or metric.
criteria.theoretical_result: A theorem, bound, proof or formal analysis.
criteria.empirical_analysis_replication: An empirical study, analysis or replication of existing work.
criteria.synthesis_survey: A survey, review, tutorial or position synthesis of prior work.
criteria.mixed_other: Several contributions of comparable weight, or a kind not listed.
criteria.insufficient_information: Missing content or ambiguity in the supplied text prevents classification.

comparative_evaluation.instructions: Does the paper report a comparison to an alternative or baseline addressing a contribution? Presence does not establish fairness or superiority. Judge only the supplied paper text; do not use outside knowledge.

criteria.reported: A comparison to an alternative or baseline addressing a contribution is reported.
criteria.explicitly_absent: The paper explicitly states that no such comparison was made.
criteria.not_reported: No qualifying statement about a comparison appears in the supplied text.
criteria.not_applicable: The question has no meaningful target in this paper.
criteria.insufficient_information: Missing content or ambiguity in the supplied text prevents classification.

ablation_component_analysis.instructions: Does the paper report isolating a component or design choice's effect? Presence does not establish causal identification. Judge only the supplied paper text; do not use outside knowledge.

criteria.reported: An analysis isolating a component or design choice's effect is reported.
criteria.explicitly_absent: The paper explicitly states no such analysis was made.
criteria.not_reported: No qualifying statement about component analysis appears.
criteria.not_applicable: The question has no meaningful target in this paper.
criteria.insufficient_information: Missing content or ambiguity in the supplied text prevents classification.

uncertainty_reporting.instructions: Does the paper report variation across repeated measurements, an interval or a statistical test for an empirical result? Presence does not establish statistical validity. Judge only the supplied paper text; do not use outside knowledge.

criteria.reported: Variation across repeats, an interval or a statistical test is reported for an empirical result.
criteria.explicitly_absent: The paper explicitly states that no such reporting was done.
criteria.not_reported: No qualifying statement appears for its empirical results.
criteria.not_applicable: The question has no meaningful target in this paper.
criteria.insufficient_information: Missing content or ambiguity in the supplied text prevents classification.

theoretical_support.instructions: Does the paper supply a proof or derivation supporting a contribution? This does not verify a proof. Judge only the supplied paper text; do not use outside knowledge.

criteria.proof_or_derivation_supplied: A proof or derivation supporting a contribution is supplied in the text or appendices.
criteria.support_elsewhere: The paper states that the support appears elsewhere.
criteria.not_reported: No qualifying statement about theoretical support appears.
criteria.not_applicable: The question has no meaningful target in this paper.
criteria.insufficient_information: Missing content or ambiguity in the supplied text prevents classification.

evaluation_beyond_main_setting.instructions: Does the paper report testing a contribution in another dataset, domain, environment or operating condition? This does not establish generalization. Judge only the supplied paper text; do not use outside knowledge.

criteria.reported: Testing in another dataset, domain, environment or operating condition is reported.
criteria.explicitly_limited_to_main_setting: The paper explicitly limits its evaluation to the main setting.
criteria.not_reported: No qualifying statement about other settings appears.
criteria.not_applicable: The question has no meaningful target in this paper.
criteria.insufficient_information: Missing content or ambiguity in the supplied text prevents classification.

artifact_availability_statement.instructions: Does the paper claim an implementation, data or model artifact is available? Available means at least one artifact is claimed available; future-only means none is claimed available and at least one is promised. No external availability is verified. Judge only the supplied paper text; do not use outside knowledge.

criteria.claimed_available: At least one implementation, data or model artifact is claimed available.
criteria.future_only: None is claimed available and at least one is promised.
criteria.explicitly_unavailable: The paper states the artifacts are not available.
criteria.not_reported: No qualifying statement about artifact availability appears.
criteria.not_applicable: The question has no meaningful target in this paper.
criteria.insufficient_information: Missing content or ambiguity in the supplied text prevents classification.

limitations_disclosure.instructions: Does the paper state a concrete assumption, failure case or scope restriction relevant to the contribution? A limitations heading alone is not a concrete disclosure. This does not measure completeness or severity. Judge only the supplied paper text; do not use outside knowledge.

criteria.concrete_limitation: A concrete assumption, failure case or scope restriction relevant to the contribution is stated.
criteria.not_reported: No qualifying statement about limitations appears.
criteria.insufficient_information: Missing content or ambiguity in the supplied text prevents classification.
